title: Exercise CMR in (p)LF-LG AS
official: Exercise CMR in (Paradoxical) Low-flow Low-gradient Aortic Stenosis
summary: Patient with paradoxical or conventional low-flow low-gradient aortic stenosis on echocardiographic assessment will undergo physiological exercise-stress CMR in addition to guideline recommended surveys prior to TAVR.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* paradoxical or conventional severe low-flow low-gradient aortic stenosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* CMR incapable device
* unable to undergo 40 min scan (can not lie flat, claustrophobia)
* renal insufficiency (eGFR \<30 ml/min/1.73m²)
* allergy against contrast agent
* unable to exercise in supine position
